phases.title: Admit Source-Backed BoM Evidence
entryCriteria: Architecture is reviewable enough to identify critical component candidates.
exitCriteria: Every critical BoM line has admitted supplier, manufacturer, MPN, unit cost and source reference.
BoM provenance manifest has zero critical missing-source claims.
phases.rationale: Critical BoM costs, suppliers, manufacturers and MPNs must be source-backed before cost claims are credible.

phases.title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
phases.rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.

topRows.issue: High-altitude unmanned aircraft operational safety case is relevant to this product class in UK / aviation authority review.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Airspace concept of operations, detect-and-avoid assumptions, command link and recovery evidence.

topRows.issue: Airborne equipment environmental conditions is relevant to this product class in Aviation engineering reference.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Temperature, vibration, electrical power and EMC environmental evidence tailored to stratospheric operation.

topRows.issue: Solar day/night energy balance review is relevant to this product class in Project engineering gate.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Solar collection, battery night-cycle, propulsion load and station-keeping wind model evidence.

topRows.issue: Station-keeping endurance uses endurance_days with medium confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Review the formula, input values and operating envelope before treating this metric as a performance claim.

topRows.issue: Stratospheric Altitude Band currently evaluates as pass against 15 to 25 km for common HAPS station-keeping concepts; outside this band needs atmospheric, power and airspace evidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Station-Keeping Endurance currently evaluates as pass against <=60 days plausible for early solar HAPS concept, 60-180 days needs strong degradation and energy evidence, >180 days is high risk.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Solar/Energy/Flight Closure currently evaluates as pass against solar DC, battery DC, propulsion power, flight control and battery monitor paths present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Payload/Telemetry/Safety Closure currently evaluates as pass against payload data, payload power, telemetry, hardwired trip, thermal path and recovery parachute present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Wing Span Envelope currently evaluates as pass against 10 to 80 m for lightweight demonstrator-to-service HAPS concepts before aeroelastic proof.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: 720 h endurance target before stratospheric energy-balance proof.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Confirm solar resource, battery reserve, wind field, degradation, payload power and recovery plan.

topRows.issue: 1.75 m/km is a trace marker, not an aerodynamic proof.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Confirm wing area, mass budget, airfoil, aeroelastic margin, launch loads and transport constraints.
